text: I was pretty smart and well dressed in London, and now I was a regular tramp. “I do not propose to let you go. If you are what you say you are, you will soon have a chance of clearing yourself. If you are what I believe you are, I do not think you will see the light much longer.” He rang a bell, and a third servant appeared from the veranda. “I want the Lanchester in five minutes,” he said.
